text.en: mental model — the system three subsystems, one goal: get raw material into the pan in a controlled, uniform state, then apply heat you can read. sharpness is edge geometry . mise en place is workstation setup . heat control is reading thermal state . understand each as a set of variables, not a set of rules. sharpness is geometry, not magic. an edge is simply where two bevels meet. when they meet at a fine line — an apex only a fraction of a micron wide — the edge concentrates your hand force onto almost no area, so it parts fibres instead of crushing them. text.en: key concepts maillard reaction what: amino acids + reducing sugars react on a dry surface >140 °c. why it matters: it invents savoury, roasted aroma that raw and boiled vegetables lack entirely. common mistake: a wet surface — it never gets past 100 °c, so it steams grey instead of browning. caramelisation what: sugars alone break down >160 °c into sweet/nutty compounds. why it matters: it is why roasted carrot and onion taste of candy. common mistake: expecting it fast — real onion caramelisation is 20–40 min, not the 5 min recipes claim. surface moisture = the enemy what

text.en: beginner mistakes & troubleshooting l2 consistent white film on the surface — is it kahm yeast or mould? causes a flat, white, sometimes wrinkled skin on the brine is kahm yeast — a harmless surface yeast that grows when there's air contact and the ferment is on the warm/slow side. fuzzy, raised, and coloured (green, black, blue, pink) growth is mould — not harmless. diagnose kahm is flat and dull-white, smells yeasty, and skims off. mould is three-dimensional and fuzzy like bread mould, in colours. anything on the submerged vegetables is essentially never mould; problems live at the air surfa
text.es: errores de principiante y solución de problemas n2 consistente película blanca en la superficie — ¿es levadura kahm o moho? causas una piel plana, blanca, a veces arrugada sobre la salmuera es levadura kahm — una levadura de superficie inofensiva que crece cuando hay contacto con el aire y el fermento está del lado cálido/lento. el crecimiento peludo, elevado y de color (verde, negro, azul, rosado) es moho — no es inofensivo. diagnosticar la kahm es plana y blanco opaco, huele a levadura, y se puede quitar rasando la superficie. el moho es tridimensional y peludo como el moho del pan, en color

text.en: mental model — the grill as two instruments picture the grill from above as two territories. over the coals (or lit burners) is the direct zone : radiant + conductive heat, 230–320 °c / 450–600 °f at the grate, the searing station. beside it, over no fuel, is the indirect zone : with the lid down it becomes a convection oven at 120–180 °c / 250–350 °f, the gentle cook-through station. food is not "on the grill" — it is in one of two rooms, and your whole job is deciding which room and for how long. fig. 1 — two-zone fire, top-down. fuel banked to one side; food shuttles between the sear statio
text.es: modelo mental — la parrilla como dos instrumentos imagina la parrilla vista desde arriba como dos territorios. sobre el carbón (o los quemadores encendidos) está la zona directa : calor radiante + conductivo, 230–320 °c / 450–600 °f en la parrilla, la estación de sellado. al lado, sin fuego debajo, está la zona indirecta : con la tapa cerrada se convierte en un horno de convección a 120–180 °c / 250–350 °f, la estación de cocción suave. la comida no está "en la parrilla" — está en una de dos habitaciones, y todo tu trabajo consiste en decidir en cuál y por cuánto tiempo. fig. 1 — fuego de dos

text.en: why this matters in a cupping you never say a coffee is bad. you say it is under-extracted, that the acidity is sharp rather than structured, that the finish drops off at eight seconds. that precision is what makes the fix obvious: grind finer, drop the ratio, raise the temperature. the kitchen version of that skill is the one most home cooks never build. they can tell a dish is disappointing. they cannot tell you which axis is off, so they add more seasoning and hope. you cannot correct what you cannot name. every correction in cooking is a control action, and a control action needs a measure

text.en: mental model — the palate as an instrument treat the palate as an instrument with a transfer function: stimulus in, perception out. it is non-linear, it drifts, it saturates, and it has no absolute zero. what it does have — and this is the whole trick — is excellent relative discrimination. you are bad at declaring this is 0.9% salt . you are very good at declaring this one is saltier than that one . every method here is built to exploit comparison and to avoid asking you for absolute judgements. three thresholds matter and they are different numbers. detection threshold : you notice something

text.en: the axes — what each one actually does nine axes carry almost everything you will ever need to diagnose. five are tastes in the strict sense, with receptors on the tongue: salt, acid, sweet, bitter, umami. three are not tastes at all — fat and richness, heat, and texture are aromatic, tactile or trigeminal — and aroma, delivered retronasally, supplies most of what people call flavour. balance is a tenth entry and it is not an axis but a relationship between the others. coffee handed you three of these in high resolution: acidity, bitterness, sweetness, plus body and aroma. food adds salt, umam
text.es: los ejes — qué hace realmente cada uno nueve ejes cargan con casi todo lo que vas a necesitar diagnosticar. cinco son sabores en sentido estricto, con receptores en la lengua: sal, ácido, dulce, amargo, umami. tres no son sabores en absoluto — grasa y untuosidad, picante y textura son aromáticos, táctiles o trigeminales — y el aroma, que llega por vía retronasal, aporta la mayor parte de lo que la gente llama sabor. el balance es una décima entrada y no es un eje sino una relación entre los demás. el café ya te dio tres de estos en alta resolución: acidez, amargor, dulzor, más cuerpo y aroma.
